name: AdvisorPPC - Google Ads, Analytics, Tag Manager, Search Console and YouTube Connector
description: AdvisorPPC Connector gives Claude tenant-isolated access to the Google Ads, Google Analytics 4, Google Tag Manager, Google Search Console and YouTube accounts a user authorizes. Its 46-tool catalog contains 33 purpose-built reads and 13 limited writes. Every included write returns a preview by default and changes provider state only when confirm=true is supplied. The directory surface excludes deletes, uploads, public publishing, free-form API proxies, media generation, money movement and non-Google provider tools.

_published_faq.name: How do I add AdvisorPPC - Google Ads, Analytics, Tag Manager, Search Console and YouTube Connector to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add AdvisorPPC - Google Ads, Analytics, Tag Manager, Search Console and YouTube Connector to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.advisorppc.com/claude. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.
